component.name: BlueJava Studio
component.summary: A fast, minimalist Java text editor built for Linux Bluefin

description.p: BlueJava Studio is a clean, ultra-fast GTK 4 and Libadwaita text editor designed specifically for editing Java code files and folders on Linux Bluefin.

ul.li: Multi-tab editing for working on multiple Java files simultaneously
Vibrant matching bracket highlighting for Java syntax
Adwaita Dark and Light native system themes
Folder navigation sidebar with single-click file opening
Inline code search (Ctrl+F) and line jumper (Ctrl+L)

description.p: Initial release of BlueJava Studio for Linux Bluefin.
